abstract: Audits venue structural safety, air exchange infrastructure, and fire evacuation permits
system_message:
You are the District safety and compliance officer (DSCO), responsible for auditing venue structural safety, air exchange infrastructure, and fire evacuation permits, as well as tracking chemical storage clearance records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chemical storage clearance（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
DSCO-HAZMAT-6T4：At Northbank Maritime Expo Centre, the chemical storage locker containment systems have a hazardous materials isolation rating of 1 tier.
DSCO-HAZMAT-EMH：At Highland Valley Convention Hub, the hazardous materials isolation rating for the chemical storage locker containment systems is verified at 2 tier.
DSCO-HAZMAT-DP5：At Riverside Aerodrome Pavilion, the chemical storage locker containment systems maintain a hazardous materials isolation rating of 3 tier.

information_points.title: Audits venue structural safety, air exchange infrastructure, and fire evacuation permits（FIRESAFE）
information_points.content:
DSCO-FIRESAFE-71I：For Northbank Maritime Expo Centre, the annual assembly safety inspection report confirms a valid district fire safety certification across all indoor assembly halls and secondary egress stairs, while the HVAC technical maintenance log documents an air conditioning filter exchange turnaround time of 18 h for the primary convention hall central air handling units.
DSCO-FIRESAFE-8ET：For Riverside Aerodrome Pavilion, a valid district fire safety certification is confirmed covering all indoor assembly halls and secondary egress stairs, and the air conditioning filter exchange turnaround time for the primary convention hall central air handling units is 16 h.
DSCO-FIRESAFE-BK9：For Highland Valley Convention Hub, the district fire safety certification is verified as valid for all indoor assembly halls and secondary egress stairs, and its air conditioning filter exchange turnaround time is 24 h according to the primary convention hall central air handling unit logs.
